newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Soccer-Dates for FAI Cup quarter-finals set.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Dates for FAI Cup quarter-finals set.

text.p: Dates for the quarter-finals of the FAI Cup were finalised between the clubs involved on Wednesday, the Football Association of Ireland said in a statement.
The FAI said the quarter-finals would be played on the weekend starting Friday, March 7. All kick-off times are given in GMT.
Bohemians vs St.Patrick's Athletic at Dalymount Park, 1930 GMT.
Waterford United vs Drogheda United at Waterford Regional Sports Centre, 1945 GMT.
Derry City vs Cork City at Brandywell, 1500 GMT.
Bray Wanderers vs Shelbourne at Carlisle Grounds, 1515 GMT.
